The [[Dark Council]] '''chamber''' on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] was much smaller than the [[Dark Council Chambers|Chamber]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. However, during the [[Great Galactic War]] it was the headquarters of the Dark Council.

The chamber itself consisted of a large platform in the middle and a few doors at each side, one for each Dark Council member.
